policy_cases.case: All known PGIDs have valid observed rows
policy_cases.disposition: Aggregate actual parsed rows/RSS and retain raw rows/state; do not call group_exists for a PGID already represented. A hypothetical PermissionError from that now-unnecessary check is not queried. This intentionally changes that observation dependency; it is not behavioral equivalence on every possible error.

policy_cases.case: Some known PGID has no observed row; group_exists returns True
policy_cases.disposition: Refuse live owned group with unavailable RSS. No absent row receives a synthetic zero value.

policy_cases.case: Some known PGID has no observed row; ProcessLookupError
policy_cases.disposition: Unchanged group_exists returns False for that missing-group query; aggregate only actual other observed rows. Absence is not inferred from ps omission alone.

policy_cases.case: Missing PGID existence check raises PermissionError or other unexpected error
policy_cases.disposition: Exception propagates; it is not caught as False/absence/success. Live direct caller keeps fatal resource_or_group_observation_failed with phase/operation/context/traceback. Existing direct-exit error-race recording remains unchanged.
Even when all missing PGID checks report absent, no-row refusal remains. A successful all-zero/no-observation sample is not introduced.

policy_cases.case: Malformed or wrong-group candidate row / failing ps return
policy_cases.disposition: Original query/row/identity ValueErrors remain. Unknown/nonnumeric/missing data is not converted to zero. Unrelated rows do not register owned groups.
